title: Super Bowl II
overview: Super Bowl II, played on January 14, 1968, at the Orange Bowl in Miami, was the second championship game between the National Football League (NFL) and the American Football League (AFL). The game featured the Green Bay Packers, once again led by head coach Vince Lombardi, facing off against the Oakland Raiders, the AFL champions coached by John Rauch. Green Bay had dominated the NFL for years and was looking to solidify its legacy, while Oakland sought to prove the AFL’s growing competitiveness.
